item.title: Jury convicts 2 in fake Michigan campaign signature scheme
item.description: A Michigan jury found two people guilty of scheming to sabotage the gubernatorial and judicial campaigns of candidates in the 2022 election by collecting fake signatures, a move that disqualified candidates from the ballot.
